meta.title: Claims in empirical economics papers
meta.tagline: The claims a paper states and the results that carry them, transcribed by the pipeline, checked against the companion tables, reviewed, released.
meta.description: The claims files of the Robustness-at-Scale pipeline enter a dataset through this workflow: uploaded into a run, re-checked against the declared contract, every cited point estimate checked against the cells of the companion tables dataset, every new claim reviewed, then released.

authors.affiliation: University of Basel; University of Copenhagen

steps.label: Estimates against the tables
steps.help: each cited point estimate against the coefficient cells of the companion tables dataset; a resolved column with no matching cell is an error, an exhibit no column matches a warning
